headline: HiArgs Struct and Its Dependencies
what_breaks: crates/core/flags/mod.rs — relies on HiArgs for high-level argument representation
crates/core/flags/parse.rs — relies on HiArgs for converting low-level arguments
why: The HiArgs struct is central to managing high-level CLI arguments, which are critical for the application's functionality. Changes to this struct or its methods can impact multiple files that depend on its representation and conversion logic.
checklist: Review changes to HiArgs struct fields and methods
Check interactions with LowArgs in from_low_args function
Ensure compatibility with modules importing HiArgs
Consider implications for dependent files like mod.rs and parse.rs
